briefing: Field Report from Agent Polaris: The current scan reveals several ongoing investigations and incidents related to fraud and data security. The FBI has executed search warrants at election facilities in Fulton County, Georgia, as part of an investigation into alleged voter fraud. Additionally, Minnesota's Department of Human Services experienced a data breach exposing over 300,000 records. These incidents highlight concerns about election integrity and data security. Further investigation into these matters is warranted to uncover potential patterns of irregularities and ensure accountability.
